notes.title: AUM X IGU Sale
notes.notes:
Discover the best of India’s indie game scene during the Indie Game Utsav Steam Sale! A celebration of homegrown creativity, innovation, and storytelling—this sale brings together some of the most exciting indie titles from across the country.

🔥 AUM The Game is proud to be part of this lineup!
Dive into a fast-paced multiplayer action-adventure where you harness ancient powers, battle across mystical arenas, and carve your own path in a universe that’s just getting started.

Don’t miss your chance to explore the future of Indian gaming—on sale for a limited time!
